items.text: cards: a slider of every design to pick from (four sizes, two styles) instead of one big card
add a message to a card; it takes the place of the sentence
cards carry the corner namemark (the index's, top right), not the centred one
every panel's title starts with the icon of the button that opens it
the sound panel's tabs show their icons; only the open tab shows its name too
the drawer caret sits clear of its button
on tall cards (post and story), CURRENT runs down the left edge, large, with the sentence beside it at the top
in the index, the beta pill sits under the name, with founding tester and share beside it
cards follow the share card's layout at every size: CURRENT and its sentence top left, the namemark top right, CHAMY·XYZ up the bottom left in blue, the code bottom right
on every card, CURRENT sits top left, across from the namemark, with its line under it; the small duck-rabbit sits over CHAMY·XYZ
cards: in share, make a card from a look for social media (post, story, square, link), with the look behind or inside the duck-rabbit, the title, the namemark and a QR code
the QR code on a card opens that exact look, live, with the duck-rabbit in its middle
a small caret over the bar's buttons that open a drawer, while it is open and on hover
